character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of an original Mega-level Cyber-Solar Gryphon Knight monster named "SolGryphmon", majestic hovering battle stance, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Body & Anatomy: Powerful hybrid humanoid gryphon frame with metallic golden lion-like armor on the lower body and muscular azure-blue cybernetic arms.
- Head & Helm: Golden eagle-beak battle helm with swept-back crown feathers, glowing crimson eyes, and a solar crest on the forehead.
- Wings & Solar Thrusters: Pair of massive mechanical wings made of layered crimson and gold solar-panel blades, venting radiant amber-orange plasma flames and digital embers from rear thrusters.
- Armor & Weaponry: Polished silver Chrome Digizoid chestplate with a glowing solar reactor core at the center; dual forearm bracers equipped with folding golden talons and integrated laser beam emitters.
- Tail & Legs: Armored mechanical lion tail ending in a laser blade, with heavy digitigrade taloned cyber-greaves.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- High-contrast metallic reflections, glowing solar plasma aura, sharp dark pixel outlines.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
